events.title: October Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in and around Old Fort at Gateway Trails and Foothills Watershed. Gateway trails do not allow e-bikes. Foothills Watershed does allow e-bikes. Post-ride social at Foothills Watershed. Multiple ride levels: Foundation, Chill, Chill Plus, Chill Plus Tech, Modrrt.

events.title: Beers + Maintenance | Trailside Tune Up
events.description: Hands-on maintenance clinic with Daily Cycle AVL covering shifting issues, chain problems, brake adjustments, and valve issues. Check-in 4:30-5:00 PM. Drink token and small snack provided. Dress in clothes you don't mind getting dirty. Bring your trail tools/kit.

events.title: Test + Tune with Cane Creek Components (Again)
events.description: Suspension test + tune with Cane Creek Components experts. Meet at Explorer Loop parking lot. Ride the same loop and dial in your suspension. Bring riding clothes, pack, snacks, and water. Location does not allow e-bikes. First 8 emails to register get a spot. Email Dorene O'Malley to register.

events.title: November Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Pisgah and DuPont. Neither location allows e-bikes. Post-ride social at Oskar Blues Brewery. Multiple ride levels available.

events.title: December Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Hot Springs. Location does not allow e-bikes. Post-ride social at Big Pillow Brewing. Multiple ride levels available.
